label: Schools and education
desc: Schools' budgets, paid by ring-fenced government grants, plus education the council pays for itself such as special needs transport

label: Care for older and disabled adults
desc: Home care, care homes and support for disabled adults

label: Children's services
desc: Children in care, family support, safeguarding and youth justice

label: Housing and homelessness
desc: Temporary accommodation and homelessness, housing advice and licensing. Council homes are a separate ring-fenced account

label: Public health
desc: Sexual health, drug and alcohol services, health visiting and school nursing, paid by a ring-fenced grant

label: Running the council
desc: Finance, IT, legal, collecting council tax, pension costs and services the return does not itemise

label: Community safety and regulation
desc: Law enforcement team, CCTV, environmental health, licensing, trading standards and cemeteries

label: Streets, waste and transport
desc: Bins, recycling, street cleaning, roads, street lights and concessionary travel, after parking income

label: Planning and the local economy
desc: Planning applications, building control and economic development

label: Debt costs and levies
desc: Interest and repayment of borrowing, London-wide levies, less investment income

label: Parks, libraries and leisure
desc: Parks and open spaces, libraries, sport and culture

label: Housing benefit (paid by government)
desc: Mandatory housing benefit, fully paid by government subsidy. Nets to zero and is left out of the chart
